import pickle, runpy

    print(name, *(round(v, 6) for v in m))
    for j,v in enumerate(m):
        if j not in worst or v > worst[j][0]: worst[j] = (float(v), name)
print('Worst scalar, trajectory, and individual horizon:', worst)
